import time
import re
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save,guard

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261103/V150-objective-floor-v1'
p=read(repo/'docs/results/v150-objective-floor-preparation-v1.json')
assert len(p['copies'])==13
for x in p['copies'].values():
    assert ref(x['original']['path'])==x['original']
    assert ref(x['public']['path'])==x['public']
    assert Path(x['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(x['public']['path']).read_bytes()
source=read(p['sources']['path']);assert ref(p['sources']['path'])==p['sources']
assert len(source['frozen_neural_hashes'])==85
for path,sha in source['frozen_neural_hashes'].items():
    assert ref(path)['sha256']==sha
    assert ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(path).name)['sha256']==sha
for x in source['sources']:
    assert ref(x['path'])['sha256']==x['sha256'] and Path(x['path']).read_text()==x['text']
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);guard(read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json'))
design=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json');assert len(design['observations'])==822 and len(design['endpoints'])==4
adc=[c for c in design['observations'] if c.get('cohort') in ['adc-photo256','adc-sloped512']]
assert len(adc)==24 and len([x for x in adc if x['kind']=='photo'])==8
assert all(x['reference_role'].startswith('Exact ') for x in adc)
for c in adc:
    assert ref(c['arrays']['path'])==c['arrays'] and ref(c['parent']['path'])==c['parent']
assert read(root/'postprocess-preflight-v1.json')['planned_primary_native_figures']==72
assert read(root/'checkpoint250-audit-v1.json')['finite_Adam_states']==24
snap=read(root/'preparation-snapshot-v1.json');assert snap['completed_native_trace_rows_exact_V149']==423
owners={**snap['owners_confirmed_live']}
live={}
for name,owner in owners.items():
    process=psutil.Process(owner['pid']);assert abs(process.create_time()-owner['created'])<.01
    assert process.is_running() and process.status() not in ['zombie','dead']
    live[name]={'owner':owner,'status':process.status()}
docs=['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/research.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/spectral-loss-allocation.md','docs/objective-floor-training.md','diary/2026-11-03-15-03-40-v150-objective-floor-trial.md']
links=0
for name in docs:
    path=repo/name
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',path.read_text()):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):continue
        assert (path.parent/link.split('#')[0]).is_file(),(name,link)
        links+=1

Historical preparation snapshot423 and checkpoint250 audit preserve their original bytes. No additional neural/noise calls.'})
print('PASS13 copies,85 neural hashes,822 cases,',links,'links and3 live owners')
